messages:
maya: Kicking off onboarding for new org 'quasar' — pilot starts in 2 weeks. Need cross-cloud quota + network prep. Primary regions: AWS us-west-2, GCP us-central1, Azure West Europe.
jonathan: Can you list exact quota asks? GPUs, public IPs, vCPUs, and any egress/bandwidth concerns?
samir: Draft below — numbers are conservative but need headroom for CI bursts and canary load testing.
- AWS (us-west-2): p4d (A100) 8 reserved, g5.4xlarge (A10G) 20 burst-capacity, Elastic IPs increase to 60 (default 5), ENI limit bump to +200, vCPU limit increase to 2048.
- GCP (us-central1): a2-highgpu-1g (A100) 4 reserved, nvidia-t4 (n1-standard + t4) 16 burst, external IP quota to 40, regional CPU quota to 1500, subnet secondary ranges ready.
- Azure (West Europe): Standard_ND40rs_v2 (A100) 4 reserved, Standard_NV series for smaller jobs 12 burst, Public IP per subscription increase to 50, vCPU cores increase to 1200, accelerated networking enabled.
tess: Also need IAM/service account checklist + billing alerts + required tags.
liam: +1. We should include a sample support ticket body for each cloud to speed requests.
jonathan: Agreed — here's a short template we used before. Keep it copy/paste friendly.
---
AWS Support case template (Quota Increase) — Subject: Quasar org production quota request (us-west-2)
Body:
Hello,

We are Redwood Inference onboarding a new customer org (Quasar) and need quota increases in region us-west-2: request temporary/permanent increases to the following service quotas:
- EC2 G4/G5 instances (g5 family): target 20 instances, please increase On-Demand and Spot quotas.
- EC2 P4d instances: target 8 instances.
- Elastic IPs: increase to 60.
- ENI (network interfaces): increase ENI per VPC by 200.
- vCPU limit (All Standard instances): increase to 2048.

We may provide additional justification and anticipated utilization metrics upon request. Point of contact: maya@redwood.com.
---
GCP Quota Request (Console -> IAM & Admin -> Quotas) sample text:
We are onboarding Quasar. Please increase regional quotas in us-central1: a2 GPUs (A100) to 4, NVIDIA T4 GPU quota to 16, external static IP quota to 40, CPUs to 1500. We will use these for inference serving and tuning. Contact: maya@redwood.com.
---
Azure Support Request sample:
Subject: Increase GPU and Public IP quotas for Quasar onboarding (West Europe)
Body: We require additional capacity for inference serving and CI bursts: increase ND-series GPUs to 4, NV-series to 12, Public IPs to 50, vCPU quota to 1200. Subscription ID: xxxxxxxx. Contact: maya@redwood.com.
---
samir: Also include the required tags/labels we need on all accounts/projects for billing and cost allocation:
- tag:BusinessUnit=Quasar
- tag:Project=quasar-inference
- tag:Environment=pilot
- tag:Owner=maya@redwood.com
- label (GCP): cost_center=quasar, env=pilot
liam: IAM checklist:
- Create org-level group: quasar-admins (saml mapped)
- Create cloud roles: quasar-infra (EC2/GCE/VM contributor + quota view), quasar-deploy (limited to deployments and logs)
- Service accounts: quasar-ops-sa (for autoscaling and metrics), quasar-build-sa (CI ephemeral machines)
tess: Network notes:
- Reserve /22 subnets in each region to avoid running out of IPs for scale testing.
- Use IGW/NAT design: ephemeral instances should route egress through NATs with egress cost tags.
- Request increased ephemeral Elastic IP pool per AZ to avoid IP exhaustion during rolling deploys.
jonathan: Can someone put numbers on expected egress/GiB per month? Need for cloud billing teams.
maya: Expect ~50TB/month initially (mostly model fetch + LR traceroute data), should be safe margin. We'll monitor.
liam: I'll draft the actual quota requests and open support tickets this afternoon.
infra-bot: [automated] Created tracking issue INFRA-9812 for Quasar onboarding — owner: liam — due: 2026-04-03
jonathan: For AWS EIP justification: mention rolling deploys + external healthchecks + canary IP pinning. That usually helps approvals.
samir: One more: ask for region pair fallback policy in case a region is capacity constrained. i.e., allow model variant fallback to smaller GPU (g5) automatically — config note for runtime team.
tess: I'll add required console link checklist to the onboarding doc:
- AWS: create org account, attach billing, set SCPs, create SAML mappings, request quotas (use template).
- GCP: create project with folder under org, attach billing account, enable Compute Engine API, request quotas, pre-create VPC and subnets.
- Azure: create subscription under RBAC structure, attach billing, enable Compute, request quotas, configure NSGs.
liam: Ticket statuses: will post case #'s here when created. ETA: today EOD.
maya: thanks — once we have case #'s, schedule a quick sync w/ product before we accept pilot.
liam: FYI -- I'll include short CLI snippets in ticket to show intended instance types:
aws example: 
aws ec2 run-instances --instance-type p4d.24xlarge --image-id ami-0abcdef --count 1 --placement AvailabilityZone=us-west-2a
GCP example: 
gcloud compute instances create gpux-1 --zone=us-central1-a --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --machine-type=n1-standard-32
Azure example: 
az vm create -n quasar-a100 -g QuasarRG --image UbuntuLTS --size Standard_ND40rs_v2 --public-ip-sku Standard
jonathan: Great. Make sure support cases request both On-Demand and Spot/Preemptible increases where applicable.
liam: Opening cases now. Will ping when done.
maya: :thumbsup:
